tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Current status of all Microsoft services, or of one service, product family or Azure region. Gives Microsoft’s official status next to our own independent measurements, and the open incidents. Use for questions like "is Outlook down?" or "is Azure West Europe OK?".

tools.name: get_incident
tools.description: One Microsoft incident by our id, Microsoft’s id (EX1234567, MO1234567, an Azure tracking id) or an incident URL: status, phase, affected services and regions, times (Microsoft’s start, first posted, first seen by us, our own detection), and every revision with the fields and words Microsoft changed

tools.name: search_incidents
tools.description: Find incidents by text (title, our id, Microsoft’s id), service, family, Azure region, state and time window. Newest first. Use to answer "what happened to Teams yesterday?" or "Azure outages in West Europe this month".

tools.name: list_changes
tools.description: What Microsoft changed recently, newest first: edits to incident texts (status, wording, affected services) and announced changes (Microsoft 365 roadmap, Azure Updates, security updates, retirements, known issues). Each item says what changed and links to the details.
